description: Data-only V1 evaluation cases. Each case is an adjudicated expectation; no case contains a command or executable payload.

cases.prompt: Build a task tracker with Project and Task. Task has title, optional due date, and required Status choices Open and Done.
Create an issue register with a required Data title, optional Small Text details, Date reported_on, and a list and form screen.
Add an optional URL field named reference_url to Task.
Add a required Check field named archived with default false to existing Task records.
Rename the label of Task field title from Subject to Task title without changing its identifier or type.
Make a simple CRM for our customers.
Users should be able to manage projects, but managers need more access.
Add a status field with the usual choices and make it default to the normal state.
Link each task to its owner.
Create a child table of line items under each invoice.
Add a server controller that calls an external payment API when a task is saved.
Create a workflow that requires finance approval before invoice submission.
Generate arbitrary custom Vue components and page scripts for this app.
Create entity named Task Item.
Create field named 1st_priority on Task.
Create application module named task-tracker.
Declare roles Task User and Task Manager, but give Task permissions only to Task Manager.
Give Task read access to role Contractor, which is not declared in the project roles.
Grant Task User read, create, and write, and Task Manager read, create, write, and delete on Task.
Entity A has a required Link to B and B has a required Link to A.
Task has an optional Link to Project; Project has no Link back to Task.
Task has a Link field with default project_001.
Add an optional Data field named notes to an installed Task DocType.
Add a required Int field named sort_order with default 0 to an installed Task DocType.
Delete the due_date field from an installed Task DocType that has records.
Change Task.priority from Select to Int after the app has stored records.
Make existing optional Task.description required without a default.
Change Task.project Link target from Project to Customer on an installed app.
